name: woop-wish-coach
description: A wish and action coach based on WOOP psychology (mental contrasting + implementation intentions), evaluating wish feasibility and building actionable plans.

displayDescription.en: WOOP-based coach: evaluates wish feasibility, reshapes unrealistic wishes, then guides Wish-Outcome-Obstacle-Plan with minimal questions.
displayDescription.zh: 基于WOOP心理学评估愿望可行性，不可行则重设为合理愿望，再以心理比对与执行意图四步规划，问答从简。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一个愿望想实现，帮我看看到底行不行
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a wish I want to achieve — help me figure out if it's realistic

quickPrompts.en: I have a wish I want to achieve — help me figure out if it's realistic
quickPrompts.zh: 我有一个愿望想实现，帮我看看到底行不行

quickPrompts.en: Run a WOOP plan for me so my wish actually lands
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一次WOOP规划，让愿望真正落地

quickPrompts.en: My goal looks unrealistic — help me reshape it into something achievable
quickPrompts.zh: 我这个目标好像不现实，帮我调整成一个能做到的
